_comment: What AlfieBot says in the spelling tutor. Several options per line; one is picked at random. Placeholders: {word}, {Word} (capital first letter), {letters} (B-E-C-A-U-S-E), {slow_letters}, {n}, {total}, {sentence}, {beats}, {count}, {score}, {first}, {length}, {answer}, {missed}, {answer}/{so_far} (the child's letters), {removed}, {n} (letter number), {options}, {option}, {example}, {heard}.
menu_question: Would you like to add this week's spellings, practise them or take a test?
Shall we add spellings, practise them or do a test?
menu_unclear: Sorry, would you like to add spellings, practise them or take a test? Or say stop to finish.
Hmm, shall we add words, practise or do a test?
no_words: We haven't got any spellings saved yet. Shall we add some? Say add the word, then your word, or type them into the spelling panel.
There aren't any spellings to use yet. Let's add some first! Say add the word, then your word.
add_intro: Let's add this week's spellings! Say add the word, then your word. Say finished when you're done.
Ready to add words! Tell me each one like this: add the word because. Say finished when you're done.
add_saved: Great! I've added {word} to your list. What's the next word?
Done! {Word} is on your list. What's next?
Got it, {word} is saved. Next word, or say finished.
add_already: {Word} is already on your list! What's the next word?
add_retry: Oops! Let's try again. Can you spell it for me, letter by letter?
Sorry about that! Please spell the word for me, one letter at a time.
add_unclear: Sorry, I didn't catch the word. Say add the word, then the word. Or say finished.
Hmm, which word shall I add? Say add the word, then the word.
add_done: Brilliant! This week's list has {count} words. Would you like to practise them or take a test?
All saved! You've got {count} words this week. Shall we practise them or do a test?
add_done_empty: Okay! We didn't add any new words. Would you like to practise or take a test?
yes_or_no: Is that right? Yes or no?
practice_intro: Let's practise! There are {total} words. Spell each one a letter at a time, then say finished. Say clue if you'd like a clue.
Practice time! We've got {total} words. Say the letters one by one, then say finished. If you get stuck, say clue.
practice_slow: Okay, nice and slowly. {Word}. {slow_letters} Now you try!
practice_done: That's all {total} words! You got {score} right first time. Would you like to take a test now?
We've practised all {total} words, and {score} were right first time. Shall we do a test?
test_intro: Spelling test time! I'll say each word, and you spell it one letter at a time. Say finished when you're done. There are {total} words.
Let's do a test! I'll say a word, you spell it letter by letter, then say finished. {total} words. Here we go!
test_wrong: Good try! We'll practise {word} together later.
Not quite, but well done for trying. We'll practise {word} later.
test_done_all: You got all {total} right! Amazing spelling!
Wow, {total} out of {total}! Every single one!
test_done_some: You got {score} out of {total}! Great effort. Let's practise {missed} again. Would you like to practise {them} now?
{score} out of {total}, well done! The tricky {ones} {were} {missed}. Shall we practise {them} now?
test_stopped: Okay, we'll stop the test there. You got {score} out of {n}. Great effort!
nothing_heard: I didn't catch any letters. Try spelling it again, letter by letter.
start_again: Okay, let's go back to the first word.
stop: Okay, we'll stop there. Great work today!
deleted_nothing: There aren't any letters to delete yet. Spell {word} when you're ready.
cleared: All cleared! Spell {word} from the start.
letters_please: I need the letters one at a time, like B, E, C. Have another go!
Can you say the letters one by one for me?
no_letters_yet: I haven't heard any letters yet. Spell {word} one letter at a time.
No letters yet! Spell {word} for me, then say finished.
no_letters_so_far: You haven't said any letters yet.
test_no_clue: No clues in a test! Have a go, or say skip.
It's a test, so no clues this time. Try your best, or say skip.
review: I've got {answer}. Is that what you meant?
review_no: Okay, let's fix it. Say delete to take off the last letter, or start again.
No problem. Say delete to rub out the last letter, or start again to clear them.
clarify_missing: I didn't catch letter {n}. What was it? You can say it like {example}.
Sorry, I missed letter {n}. Can you tell me it again, like {example}?
clarify_one: Was letter {n} {option}? Say yes, or tell me the right letter.
I think letter {n} was {option}. Is that right?
clarify_which: Okay, what was letter {n}? You can say it like {example}.
clarify_again: Sorry, I still didn't catch letter {n}. Can you say it like {example}?
Hmm, I'm not sure about letter {n}. Try saying it like {example}.
practice_retest: Let's try {word} again, now you've learned it. Can you spell {word}?
Remember {word}? Let's see if you can spell it now.
practice_slow_beats: Okay, nice and slowly. {beats}. {Word}. Now you try!
practice_taught_correct: Yes! You learned {word}! We'll practise it again soon.
Brilliant, you remembered it! {Word} is getting easier.
practice_taught_wrong: Good try! {Word} is a tricky one. We'll come back to it in a little while.
Well done for trying. We'll have another go at {word} soon.
test_wrong_reveal: Not quite, but well done for trying. It's {letters}.
test_skip_reveal: No problem. {Word} is spelled {letters}. We'll practise it later.
